value.rationale: Sharp two-input stability for the natural root-and-leaves partial order is motivated by hierarchical isotonic regression and weighted graph total variation. It yields a full multiweight contraction classification, a first branching instability at four uniformly weighted leaves, and an explicit all-parameter norm usable for perturbation bounds, not a routine total-order corollary.
